 Stars of Comedy Series ‘Dig’ Talk Strong Female Characters 
 14:37 
 Copied 
 Copied 
 Amy Poehler and Geraldine Viswanathan join TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to talk about working together on their new Peacock comedy series “Dig,” how they bonded over karaoke, and what drew them to the project. “We love the project because there are so many good parts for women,” Amy says. Then, they’re joined by their co-stars Fina Strazza and Antonia Thomas for a hilarious game of Scoot It and Boot It. Nov. 16, 2026
